items.title: Professional Cover Letter & Leadership Philosophy
items.teaser: A structured personal statement articulating how high-stakes military compute accuracy, enterprise catalog stewardship, and human empathy converge into high-leverage systems.

letterSections.heading: The Intersection of Clinical Precision and Human Empathy
letterSections.body: In high-consequence environments—whether computing ballistic firing solutions where a transposed digit risks catastrophe, or governing multi-million-dollar enterprise catalog lines—data fidelity is not an abstract preference; it is an ethical obligation. My career has been defined by bridging this technical precision with genuine, human-centered stewardship.

letterSections.heading: Enterprise Data Stewardship at Grainger
letterSections.body: At Grainger, I steward high-velocity product information across portfolios averaging $148 million. When chaotic, non-standardized supplier spec sheets created ingestion bottlenecks, I did not merely execute manual entry. I engineered generative AI parsing frameworks that compressed research task completion times by 40%, freeing analyst bandwidth to engage suppliers in strategic quality consultations.

letterSections.heading: Operational Leadership & Talent Systems
letterSections.body: As a Hiring Manager on stretch assignment and Customer Experience Supervisor, I recognized that operational throughput depends entirely on psychological safety and clear systems. When tasked with managing 40 candidate interviews weekly across 25+ stakeholders during a corporate site merger, I built automated Smartsheet telemetry to eliminate interview fatigue. Concurrently, by restructuring hybrid onboarding around modular peer coaching, we reduced time-to-proficiency by 60 days.

letterSections.heading: Military Doctrine: Calm Under Degraded Conditions
letterSections.body: My six years in the Wisconsin Army National Guard as both a Fire Direction Specialist and Chaplain's Assistant forged a rare duality: the clinical discipline required for 100% tactical computational accuracy, paired with the discretion and pastoral empathy required to de-escalate crises between soldiers and command. I bring this unflappable calm and craftsmanship to every enterprise challenge.

items.title: High-Discharge Custom Electric Skateboards & VESC Telemetry
items.teaser: Engineered bespoke personal electric vehicles from scratch: spot-welded 12S4P 21700 lithium battery packs, programmed VESC field-oriented motor control, and machined CNC drivetrains.

story.inception: Commercial off-the-shelf electric skateboards suffer from thermal throttling under sustained incline loads, generic speed controller lag, and battery enclosures with fragile solder joints prone to road vibration failure.
story.challenge: Safely delivering 80+ amps of continuous electrical current through a compact physical deck while dampening high-frequency road vibrations, preventing cell puncture, and modeling thermal dissipation without active fan cooling.
story.strategy: Hand-built a custom 12S4P battery pack using genuine Molicel P42A 21700 cells spot-welded with slotted pure nickel sheets and fishpaper insulation. Programmed open-source VESC speed controllers via Bluetooth telemetry, fine-tuning throttle ramp curves and linear regenerative braking.
story.outcome: Constructed high-torque, reliable belt-drive boards tested over hundreds of road miles with zero cutouts or thermal shutdowns. Hands-on mastery of electrical thermodynamics, mechanical stress tolerances, and firmware tuning.

items.title: 3D Bas-Relief Sculptural Art & Light Falloff Physics
items.teaser: Exploring physical surface depth through sub-millimeter bas-relief modeling, calculating directional light falloff, and compressing 3D forms into millimeters of tactile relief.

story.inception: In bas-relief sculpting, full three-dimensional anatomical and architectural forms must be flattened into mere millimeters of physical depth. The visual illusion of mass and depth relies entirely on how incident light catches carved bevel edges.
story.challenge: Balancing steep edge undercuts that create dark cast shadows with gradual draft angles that catch soft specular glints, without losing anatomical proportion.
story.strategy: Meticulously calculate how light angles interact with carved contours—a physical discipline directly mirrored in this website's carved UI cards and dynamic mouse-tracking specular highlights.
story.outcome: Physical artworks that reward patient, close inspection. The discipline of the craft directly informs professional data integrity: respecting materials, honoring historical methods, and understanding that lasting systems require meticulous patience.

items.title: Atlantic Saltwater Hydrology & Tolkien Lore
items.teaser: Studying Atlantic lunar tidal current shifts along Hutchinson Island, practicing patient observational stewardship, and analyzing Tolkien's mythological linguistic frameworks.

specs.label: Observation Cycle
specs.note: Tracking 6-hour Atlantic flood and ebb shifts

specs.label: Water Ecosystem
specs.note: Salinity, water clarity, and predator movement

story.inception: Coastal saltwater ecosystems and deep literary legendariums share a profound commonality: they are governed by subtle, underlying rules that cannot be rushed or approximated.
story.challenge: In saltwater fishing and coastal observation, conditions change hour-by-hour based on wind shear, lunar gravity, barometric pressure, and water temperature. Impatience yields nothing.
story.strategy: Cultivate the habit of quiet, sustained observation. Read the rip currents, observe baitfish displacement along underwater shelves, and study how J.R.R. Tolkien constructed enduring mythological credibility through linguistically consistent sub-creation.
story.outcome: A deeply grounded mindset that resists modern superficiality. Whether analyzing catalog taxonomies or reading an Atlantic tidal rip, patient observation reveals the true structure beneath the surface.
